title: The Wheel objects' sprite-sheet pages (wanted, loading, ready, failed, dropped)
oneLine: Each object sprite sheet streamed in near the view, kept as colour numbers or a picture, dropped when far.
topConcern: A failed page is never retried while you stay near: its buildings and trees stay invisible and walk-through until you go 1000 px away.

title: A Wheel object's hit, break and mending as drawn (shake, rubble, fade back)
oneLine: Per object: whole, shaking, broken (shards, no footprint), mending (fade); driven by wheelBreak's lossy event buffer.
topConcern: The 64-event buffer drops its oldest; a slime blast (40 objects) or a hidden tab overflows it, leaving rubble under mended objects.

title: Shatter heaps (cut, flying, bounced, lying, fading, gone)
oneLine: A broken object's shards: falling, bouncing, lying in a heap until mended or pushed out by the pixel cap.
topConcern: A heap has no expiry of its own; a lost 'repair' leaves it lying until the cap or leaving the Wheel.

title: The walk test's footprints and the one zone-blocker hook (Wheel, farm, arena)
oneLine: Which footprints stop your boots: the Wheel's live list rebuilt on several triggers, or the farm's or arena's.
topConcern: Rebuilds key on the COUNT of ready pages: a drop plus a load between frames leaves a stale list until you move.

title: A tree you stand behind going see-through, and a mended object fading in
oneLine: Per drawn sprite: eased see-through alpha under a crown, times the mend fade-in alpha.
topConcern: A repair whose break event was lost fades a never-removed tree in from zero: a blink.

title: A dungeon mouth: its picture (loading, ready, failed, far, freed) and its display
oneLine: Each mouth's picture loaded near, freed 10 s after far; drawn in code until the picture is ready.
topConcern: Pictures are freed only by update() calls that stop after a renderer rebuild outside the Wheel: ~2 MB held until you return.

title: The Wheel's ground pieces (wanted, laying, laid, short, re-laying, freed) and the overview under them
oneLine: Per 192 px ground piece: asked of the worker, laid, re-laid when a missing picture comes, freed when far.
topConcern: A worker job has no timeout; a silent worker leaves three slots in flight and nothing new laid.

title: The moving water: the program (untried, built, cannot) and a quad per piece hiding the ground under open sea
oneLine: Whether this device draws moving water, and each ground piece's water quad hiding open-sea ground.
topConcern: The built/cannot answer is decided against the first renderer only; a rebuilt one compiles the program on its first water frame.

title: The farm's pictures (loading, ready, freed) under a generation stamp
oneLine: The farm's art set loaded behind the farm trip's hold and freed on leaving, stamped by generation.
topConcern: A farm picture landing after you left is neither kept nor unloaded: up to ~9 MB stays in Pixi's cache until the next visit.

title: Your farm's beds as drawn: soil, crop stage, label, the ripe chime and the work's flying bits
oneLine: Each bed's soil, crop stage and label redrawn from the worker's farm_state; a ripe chime edge; work beats.
topConcern: Label words come from the client's copy of the worker's rules (bedNext); drift shows a step the worker refuses.

title: A dungeon arena's furnishings and the boss's chest (dropping, shut, open, glinting)
oneLine: The arena's things and life built once; the clear's chest drops, opens and glints by the reward's stamp.
topConcern: The lid's moment is a copy of the card's timing (CHEST_OPEN_MS); changing one splits them.

title: The dropped-item picture cache (loading, ready, failed, unheld, gone) with hold counts
oneLine: Per bag picture: loading, ready, failed or trimmed, held by piles and drop lines, at most 24 unheld kept.
topConcern: A failed picture is never fetched again while its entry lives: that item stays a stand-in mark.

title: A kill's drop lines (built, staggered in, rising, fading, gone) over a list two sides write
oneLine: Each kill's drop group: built, rebuilt when a late line arrives, lines staggered in and faded, pruned by both sides.
topConcern: A throw part-way through building a group leaves earlier lines' picture holds never released.

title: The preloaded icon sets: coin piles, rare-loot icons, the resource tools
oneLine: Three memoised load-once icon tables behind the global loading gate; a failure is permanent with a stand-in.

title: A resource's label (built, tool alone, full pill, hidden, killed)
oneLine: Per drawn gather node: its tool alone, or name and level for the nearest; killed with the node's display.

title: A Wheel resource near the view: drawn or not, its ore break 'played', and its fish
oneLine: Per Wheel gather node: near/far with hysteresis, a break-played flag written in two files, a swimming school.
topConcern: The tool filter short-circuits the near test, so stale hysteresis replays a vein's break animation mined while you were away.

title: The Wheel's small map pictures: building icons and land icons
oneLine: Building and land icons loaded behind the Wheel's screen, freed on leaving after their holders are cleared.
topConcern: No generation stamp: icons decoding at the free write themselves back; WheelSignposts never leaves the holder set.

title: BroTown's signpost plates (far, popping up, shown, fading, dropped) and their knock
oneLine: Per gate signpost: plates fade and pop up with your distance, a knock once each time they come up.

title: Lil Bro's race flags (none, made, later / next / done, dropped)
oneLine: The race course's flags drawn from S._race; each flag later, next or done, pennant redrawn on change only.

title: A zone's footprint strip (none, loading, sliced, freed)
oneLine: The snow-print strip per zone: loaded behind the zone's overlay, sliced, slices dropped before the unload on leaving.
topConcern: Leaving mid-load lets slices of the destroyed picture be stored; the next visit trusts them: no prints for the session.

title: How each drawn Wheel object casts its shadow (waiting, columns, billboard, building)
oneLine: A per-sprite caster record switching from billboard to columns once its picture's bases are read.

title: The old map's prop ground profile (unmeasured, measured, unreadable)
oneLine: A measure-once ground profile on each old-map prop sprite; only 'town' and 'frost' props, both retired.

title: The buildings' life on the Wheel, lost after a black-screen rebuild
oneLine: Building life textures made by the way-in warm only, freed by every WheelObjects destroy, read at sprite creation.
topConcern: After a rebuild in the Wheel nothing re-warms them: BroTown's smoke, lamps and flags are gone until you leave and re-enter.
